summary.text: Aristotle "Ari" Eliopoulos is an independent candidate for New Jersey's 8th Congressional District. He describes himself as an educator, union leader, and special needs advocate, the son of working-class immigrants. According to his Ballotpedia survey, he is running on education reform, healthcare affordability, and independence from party establishments.

paragraphs.text: Describes himself as the son of working-class immigrants, raised to believe that hard work, education, community, and service are foundations of a strong society.
Works as a teacher and union leader; says his classroom experience shaped his focus on students, families, and educators.
Describes special needs advocacy as the policy issue he is most passionate about, citing his work as an educator with students with disabilities and their families.
Is running as an independent; says his campaign principle is "Results, Not Rhetoric."
